records.rule: A model, population, optimizer or RNG is a driveable ooRexx object with retained history, not a disposable fit result.
Rollback preserves the old future; mutation after rewind creates another retained branch from the same ancestor.
Checkpoint all cooperating learning participants together whenever consistency spans more than one object.
Stochastic replay is only reproducible when deterministic RNG state and draw position are part of the same historical checkpoint.
Publish immutable learned generations for comparison; never let a historical generation alias mutable live state.
Represent genuine source/domain discontinuities explicitly and require domain policy to decide which learned state crosses the barrier.
Observation, feature, model output, assessment, claim and action are distinct; model inference never grants operational authority by itself.
ML consumes ooRexx Maths for numerical meaning, precision and evidence instead of growing private matrix/tensor arithmetic.
Foreign tensors, Python proxies, GPU handles and native pointers are execution resources, not durable journal values.
Layered Audio generic ML/tensor semantics should migrate upward in a staged rebase; avoid duplicate class ownership while v0.21 remains current.
Camera learned generations and source barriers are precedents for generic ML generations/barriers, while camera-specific semantics stay in Camera.
Treat a GA generation like a replayable machine event: before-checkpoint, evaluate, derive, commit, after-checkpoint, publish evidence.
Source-code history and learned-state history are separate timelines and both may be recorded in a generation provenance record.
Every new stateful learning component requires rollback/roll-forward/branch replay regressions before algorithm breadth or acceleration.
Executable source/tests and exact upstream dependency artifacts override the continuity sphere if they conflict.
A training checkpoint must include every state owner that changes continuation: model, optimizer, session and RNG/data cursor when present.
Learning rate, momentum/velocity and optimizer step are driveable historical state; do not hide them as ephemeral implementation detail.
Evidence-grade datasets and derived partitions retain stable dataset/sample identity, parent/transform provenance and role.
A shuffled train/test/fold partition is reproducible only when the deterministic RNG state used to create it is retained or reconstructible.
Cross-validation produces per-fold model-state and prediction evidence, not only an aggregate score.
Compare retained model futures against the same dataset without moving the caller's live branch/controller position or deleting either future.
MLLinearGDRegressor proves the explicit optimizer/session contract can drive a real iterative estimator while remaining Python-free.
A complete GA search must evaluate and publish the final bred population; low-level step() intentionally leaves its replacement population unevaluated.
Budget GA work in evaluated populations. Requested evaluations, unique normalized evaluations and retained outputs are separate counts.
Domain evaluators return natural scores; MLObjective/fitness adapter owns MINIMIZE/MAXIMIZE orientation so sign conversion is not duplicated in consumers.
Search lanes declare their parameter domains. A narrower GA domain cannot be interpreted as equivalent to a wider grid domain without explicit comparison evidence.
Workspace cap, free-space reserve, spill policy and retained-output limit are fail-closed deployment contracts.
Human review is append-only evidence separate from model output. Reopening or branching a review never erases the earlier decision.
Weighted objectives remain hypotheses until pairwise or other review evidence demonstrates adequate agreement under an explicit qualification policy.
UNDECIDABLE is a legitimate reviewer outcome and is excluded from preference-agreement denominators instead of being coerced into a false label.
Recovered-audio clipping penalty weights 18 and 40 are experimental; dev4 provides calibration machinery but does not assert perceptual validity.
dev4 repairs MLSearchSpace.containsConfiguration so declared values pass while out-of-domain and missing values fail; keep the regression.
Keep independent objectives as vectors. Dominance requires no worse on every objective and better on at least one; mixed tradeoffs remain non-dominated.
Crowding distance is a diversity/tie-break signal inside a Pareto front, not a hidden quality objective.
Pareto evolution follows the same machine-event discipline as scalar GA: checkpoint, evaluate/front-rank, deterministic breed, commit, checkpoint, publish, and score final offspring on complete runs.
Bounded retention proceeds front-by-front and may use crowding for diversity; do not materialize every evaluated candidate or invent a scalar solely to trim storage.

Recovered-audio resemblance, pre-limiter over-range and post-limiter clipping can be kept as separate objectives; the historical 18/40 penalties remain a calibratable scalar policy, not physical truth.
Hard eligibility is a gate, not an objective. An infeasible candidate can remain evidence but no objective advantage can make it a Pareto answer.
When hard constraints can be assessed from candidate configuration, reject infeasible candidates before expensive objective scoring and publish no objective vector.
Constrained Pareto evolution may use feasibility/violation count to navigate back toward the feasible region, but only feasible candidates participate in dominance and promotion.
ML owns experiment/checkpoint/frontier semantics; Storage Fabric owns workspace safety, replica verification, lifecycle and durable-completion truth.
Successful or verified work on disposable/temporary capacity is still provisional until a safe/stable verified durable replica exists.
Cross-storage ML checkpoint/frontier records carry value identity and evidence, never live journal/controller, tensor, Python proxy or native handle state.
Recovered-audio Strategy P is additive constrained-Pareto search rebased on audio_rexx_search_v0.12-dev5; inherited A/B/C/D/E semantics remain upstream-owned.

Binary logistic regression is a driveable two-class probabilistic estimator; when probability semantics matter, the positive label should be supplied explicitly rather than inferred from arbitrary label ordering.
Gaussian Naive Bayes retains class priors, per-feature means and variances with a positive variance floor; prediction compares log scores to avoid multiplying tiny densities.
Decision-tree depth/split/gain policy is branchable state; learned Gini tree nodes are immutable historical evidence and should be compared across retained policy branches rather than overwritten.
Reference k-means uses deterministic maximin initialisation and retains centroids, assignments, inertia and convergence evidence; it has no hidden RNG state.
PCA is a provenance-preserving driveable transform: learned means/components/eigenvalues are historical state and transformed datasets preserve sample ids with derived PCA provenance.

Close-neighbour hashing is distance-bearing and significance ordered: the largest weighted quantised discrepancy dominates every collection of finer differences, then the next-largest discrepancy breaks ties.
Numeric adjacency is defined in ordered quantised coordinates, not packed binary representation; crossing a binary carry boundary must not turn a one-bin change into a large hash distance.
Keep the source index exact and express tolerance as bounded query-side multi-probe. Probe budgets fail closed rather than silently truncating arbitrary buckets.
Good-enough retrieval is qualified against an exact oracle using recall@k and candidate fraction examined; do not call an approximate index good merely because examples look plausible.
For 18-bit-like audio landmarks, neighbouring time/frequency bins belong in the generic ML close-neighbour probe policy rather than an audio-private duplicated tolerant index.
Pattern hashing identifies relative curve geometry rather than absolute values: offset, amplitude and source sample density may change while the polar pattern remains identical.
The reference curve representation is circular: source minimum is the centre, normalized value is radius, and normalized curve progress is angle.
Pattern difference is significance ordered across radial, slope and curvature evidence; the largest structural disagreement dominates collections of smaller residual differences.
Rotation invariance is explicit and reversal invariance is opt-in; never erase phase or traversal direction unless the domain declares them non-semantic.
Pattern hashing is easy to undervalue until seen. Keep the polar visual demo as qualification evidence: affine and denser-sampled copies overlay exactly while changed turning structure diverges.
Temporal pattern identity maps event progress to angle, normalized channel state to radius and event time to height; circular pattern geometry must not invent a last-to-first temporal segment.
Adjacent cylindrical events retain 3-D direction evidence: planar bearing, temporal elevation and turn angle, so timing changes can separate otherwise similar radial shapes.
Time shift/scale invariance is explicit domain policy. Global scaling may be ignored, but local timing fluctuation must remain visible.
Vector-valued temporal events retain named channels independently; significance weights are policy and must not be mistaken for causal truth or a hidden scalarized model.

Keep the market cognitive-trap demo: nominal price lookalikes can be far when FX/relative/volatility differ, while numerically unrelated affine/time-scaled economic twins can be exact under declared invariance.
